free_tier.stated: The first 200 million tokens for voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-context-4 and voyage-code-4, and the first 50 million tokens for voyage-multilingual-2, voyage-finance-2, voyage-law-2 and voyage-code-2, are free for every account. For the multimodal endpoint the first 200 million text tokens and 150 billion pixels for voyage-multimodal-3.5 and voyage-multimodal-3 are free for every account.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: 200 million embedding tokens is enough to embed roughly 100 GiB of English text once, which is a whole RAG corpus, and it pairs with a free Postgres plus pgvector on Neon or Supabase so the vector store costs nothing either; what breaks is any re-index, because the allowance is consumed and does not reset.

limits.value: the 200 million tokens is a lifetime allowance per account and not a monthly one, so an index built once against it cannot be rebuilt or extended at the same price; a re-embed after a model change consumes the remainder immediately.
